entity.name: EmbeddedOS Research Foundation
entity.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit developing formally verified open-source embedded operating systems and secure bootloaders for RISC-V and ARM microcontrollers.

projects.name: eos — Embedded Real-Time Operating System
projects.description: MIT-licensed RTOS for RISC-V RV32IM and ARM Cortex-M. 15.8 KB flash, 171 MCU families, AES-128/256, SHA-256/512.

projects.name: eBoot — Secure Bootloader
projects.description: MIT-licensed secure bootloader with Ed25519 + SHA-512 chain-of-trust. 83 board configurations.
